name: Telegram answers
description: Sends you on Telegram every question, pop-up and permission prompt a chat waits on, with its choices as buttons; tap or reply there to answer. What else you write to the bot goes to a role (the COO), whose answers and a morning brief come back there. Uses its own bot, long polling only (no public address needed).

What else you write to the bot goes to a role (the COO), whose answers and a morning brief come back there. Uses its own bot, long polling only (no public address needed).

settings.label: Bot token
settings.hint: From @BotFather. Use a bot only pi uses: only one program can read a bot's messages. Stored encrypted.

settings.label: Your Telegram id
settings.hint: Only this person can answer, and only in a private chat with the bot. Everyone else is ignored.

settings.label: Web app address
settings.hint: Used for the "Open the chat" link under each question, e.g. https://my-machine.my-tailnet.ts.net:8787/

settings.label: Messages go to
settings.hint: A role's id. What you write to the bot (other than answers) goes to that role's home chat, and its answers come back. Empty: off, the bot only sends questions.

settings.label: Morning brief at
settings.hint: HH:MM, Pacific time. Each day the role above sends you a short brief then (if pi was down, as soon as it's back, until noon). Empty: off.
